summary: OpenAI and Broadcom announced a custom LLM inference chip called Jalapeño intended to improve performance, efficiency and scale for AI inference systems.

mechanisms.reason: A frontier lab is co-developing a custom inference chip with a merchant silicon partner, displacing reliance on general-purpose accelerators.
mechanisms.quote: OpenAI and Broadcom introduce Jalapeño, a custom AI chip built for LLM inference to improve performance, efficiency, and scale across AI systems.

categories.reason: The announcement centers on a new custom AI inference chip built specifically for LLM workloads.

notable_reason: A named OpenAI-Broadcom custom inference chip is a concrete, high-relevance data point for the custom silicon substitution thesis in the accelerator category.
